diagnostic_control_design.normalization: 30 fixed fits: three windows, core/core_head, LogisticRegression C=1 with standard/session_center/session_robust; ExtraTrees 200 trees, leaf=5, max_features=.8 with standard/session_center; fitting only outer Train, scoring outer validation, no new Test predictions
diagnostic_control_design.neighbors: 1NN, StandardScaler fit inside each fold, core_head14, pooled OOF over the same outer Train rows; StratifiedKFold(5,shuffle=True,random_state=42) versus stored repeat-0 purged block folds; random split intentionally permits overlap and is not a valid final result
diagnostic_control_design.monitor: original monitor_indices, reconstructed block IDs from union of three windows, 240-second anchors, both stored CV repeats; metadata-only replay without neural training
diagnostic_control_design.limits: No full notebook rerun, no hyperparameter search, no raw-data edit, no official-model replacement; diagnostic control scores are not independent final evaluation
